apps.name: logstock_companion_app
iosLinuxLimits: the app builds its iOS plugins with CocoaPods, and Linux iOS builds need Swift Package Manager (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager)

findings.message: There is no .fvmrc, so XPath does not know which Flutter version to build with.
findings.fix: Add a .fvmrc with {"flutter": "x.y.z"} to the app or to the repository root.

findings.message: Needs a Mac for iOS: Linux runners cannot build it because the app builds its iOS plugins with CocoaPods, and Linux iOS builds need Swift Package Manager (flutter config --enable-swift-package-manager).
findings.fix: Nothing to do to build on a Mac. To build on Linux (ADR 0014), lift each reason; until then its iOS jobs wait for a Mac (ios-sign).
